name: cancelInvitation
title: Cancel a pending Invitation
description: The Owner cancels a pending Invitation: its link stops working and it leaves the pending list.

name: changeMemberRole
title: Change a Member's role
description: The Owner gives another Member a new role: any role of the Product but `owner`. Nobody changes their own role (`OWN_ROLE`). Answers the Member with the new role.

role.description: The new role: any role of the Product but `owner`.

name.description: The Member's name.

role.description: The Member's role: `owner`, `employee`, or a role the Product adds.

suspended.description: Whether the Member is suspended: they keep their place but cannot enter the Company, because the Owner's Seats fall short.

name: createCompany
title: Create a Company
description: Creates a Company with this name (the spaces around it are removed; names may repeat) and makes the signed-in user its Owner. Answers the new Company.

name.description: The Company's name: 1 to 100 characters once the spaces around it are removed.

id.description: The Company's id: random, and it never changes.

name.description: The Company's name; several Companies may share it.

role.description: The signed-in user's role in the Company.

name: createInvitation
title: Invite someone to a Company
description: The Owner invites an email address to the Company with a role (never `owner`). The Invitation lasts 7 days, and an email with its link goes to the address. Refused with 409 when the address is already a Member, already has a pending Invitation (resend that one instead), or the Owner has no free Seat: remove someone, cancel an Invitation or upgrade the Plan (`NO_FREE_SEAT`; only where billing is on).

role.description: The role the person will have: any role of the Product but `owner`.
The role the person will have: `employee` or a role the Product adds.

userId.description: The user id of whoever invited.

name.description: Their name.

invitedBy.description: Who invited; `null` once their account is deleted (the Invitation stays).

expiresAt.description: When the link stops working, 7 days after it was sent or last resent.

name: createNote
title: Create a note
description: Answers the note it would create for the signed-in user. Nothing is stored.

authorId.description: The id of the user the request acts for.

name: getCompany
title: Get a Company
description: Answers a Company the signed-in user is a Member of, with their role. Opened from the app (not by an agent), it becomes the Company they land on next time.

id.description: The Company's id: random, and it never changes.

name.description: The Company's name; several Companies may share it.

role.description: The signed-in user's role in the Company.

name: getCompanyNote
title: Get a Company's welcome note
description: Answers who the signed-in user is in the Company, as the Skeleton's `requireMember` resolved it.

userId.description: The id of the user the request acts for.

role.description: Their role in the Company, as stored.

skeletonRole.description: What the role counts as on the Skeleton's routes.

name: getLastCompany
title: Get the Company the signed-in user used last
description: Answers the Company the signed-in user last opened in the app or, if they never opened one, the first they joined. Answers 404 when they are a Member of no Company.

id.description: The Company's id: random, and it never changes.

name.description: The Company's name; several Companies may share it.

role.description: The signed-in user's role in the Company.

annotations.title: Get the Company the signed-in user used last

name: getMe
title: Get the signed-in user
description: Answers the id, name and email of the user the request acts for, and the email they asked to change to, if any.

name.description: The user's name: the one they signed up with, or the last one they chose.

pendingEmail.description: The address the user asked to change their email to, until they open the link sent there; null when no change is pending.

name: getNote
title: Get a note
description: Answers the note `welcome`; any other id is not found.

authorId.description: The id of the user the request acts for.

name: getPlan
title: Get the signed-in user's Plan
description: Answers the Plan the user is on (`plan`; `null` only when Stripe has no free Plan to fall back to), their Subscription (`null` on the free Plan) and every Plan the Product sells. A person without a Subscription is on the free Plan. The Plans are read from Stripe and kept for 5 minutes. Answers 404 when billing is off.

id.description: The Plan's id: what subscribePlan takes.

name.description: The Plan's name, as set in Stripe.

description.description: What the Plan offers, as set in Stripe.

kind.description: `free`: no price. `fixed`: one monthly price for a fixed number of Seats. `per_seat`: a monthly price for each Seat.

seats.description: The Seats a `free` or `fixed` Plan gives; `null` when each Seat is paid for.

amount.description: The monthly price in the currency's smallest unit (cents).

interval.description: How often the price is charged.

price.description: The monthly price; `null` for the free Plan.

trialDays.description: The days of free trial a person's first Subscription to this Plan gets; 0 when there is none. Only a `fixed` Plan has one, and a person has one trial ever.

entitlements.description: What the Plan unlocks, by the Product's Entitlement names: on or off, or up to a number.

periodEnd.description: When the current period ends and the Subscription renews.

cancelAtPeriodEnd.description: Whether the Subscription ends when the current period does.

pastDueUntil.description: While `past_due`: the last day to update the card before Stripe gives up and the person goes back to the free Plan; `null` otherwise.

losingAccess.description: How many people lose access to the user's Companies when the paid Plan ends: the Seats taken beyond the free Plan's.

subscription.description: The person's Subscription; `null` when they are on the free Plan.

id.description: The Plan's id: what subscribePlan takes.

name.description: The Plan's name, as set in Stripe.

description.description: What the Plan offers, as set in Stripe.

kind.description: `free`: no price. `fixed`: one monthly price for a fixed number of Seats. `per_seat`: a monthly price for each Seat.

seats.description: The Seats a `free` or `fixed` Plan gives; `null` when each Seat is paid for.

amount.description: The monthly price in the currency's smallest unit (cents).

interval.description: How often the price is charged.

price.description: The monthly price; `null` for the free Plan.

trialDays.description: The days of free trial a person's first Subscription to this Plan gets; 0 when there is none. Only a `fixed` Plan has one, and a person has one trial ever.

entitlements.description: What the Plan unlocks, by the Product's Entitlement names: on or off, or up to a number.

plans.description: Every Plan the Product sells, read from Stripe (kept for 5 minutes).

name: getSeats
title: Get the Seats the signed-in user uses
description: Answers how many Seats the user's Plan gives (`total`; `null` when there is no limit), how many are taken (`used`) and the people of each Company the user owns. The Owner, each Member and each pending Invitation take a Seat, counted once per person across the user's Companies. A user who owns no Company uses 1. Answers 404 when billing is off.

used.description: The Seats taken: each distinct person in the Companies the user owns, once.

total.description: The Seats the Plan gives; `null` when there is no limit.

name.description: Its name.
Their name; `null` for an address that was only invited.

companies.description: The people of each Company the user owns. A person in two of them appears in both and takes one Seat.

annotations.title: Get the Seats the signed-in user uses

name: inviteFromNotes
title: Invite someone as an Employee, as any Member
description: A Product's own Invitation rule: any Member invites, always with the role `employee`, through the Skeleton's `createInvitation`.

annotations.title: Invite someone as an Employee, as any Member

name: leaveCompany
title: Leave a Company
description: The signed-in user stops being a Member of the Company, a Suspended Member too. From the next call on, they get 404 on every route of the Company, their agents included. The Owner cannot leave before transferring the ownership (`OWNER_MUST_TRANSFER`).

name: listCompanies
title: List the signed-in user's Companies
description: Answers the Companies the signed-in user is a Member of, with their role in each, in the order they joined: a page of `limit` (50 by default) and the `nextCursor` of the next page.

limit.description: How many items to answer, 1 to 100.

cursor.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page; without it, the first page.

id.description: The Company's id: random, and it never changes.

name.description: The Company's name; several Companies may share it.

role.description: The signed-in user's role in the Company.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

name: listConnections
title: List the signed-in user's Connections
description: Answers the AI agents the user the request acts for authorized over MCP: the app's name, when it was authorized and its access (`read` or `write`). Pages of `limit` (default 50); pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor` for the next one.

limit.description: How many Connections per page, 1 to 100.

id.description: The Connection's id: what revokeConnection takes.

appName.description: The name the agent's app gave itself when it connected.

createdAt.description: When the user authorized the agent.

access.description: `read`: the agent only reads; `write`: it also changes data.

connections.description: One page of the user's Connections.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

name: listInvitations
title: List a Company's pending Invitations
description: The Owner sees the Company's pending Invitations (email, role, who invited and when it expires), oldest first, accepted and canceled ones left out: a page of `limit` (50 by default) and the `nextCursor` of the next page.

limit.description: How many items to answer, 1 to 100.

cursor.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page; without it, the first page.

role.description: The role the person will have: `employee` or a role the Product adds.

userId.description: The user id of whoever invited.

name.description: Their name.

invitedBy.description: Who invited; `null` once their account is deleted (the Invitation stays).

expiresAt.description: When the link stops working, 7 days after it was sent or last resent.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

name: listMembers
title: List a Company's Members
description: Answers the Members of a Company the signed-in user belongs to (name, email, role and whether they are suspended), in the order they joined: a page of `limit` (50 by default) and the `nextCursor` of the next page.

limit.description: How many items to answer, 1 to 100.

cursor.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page; without it, the first page.

name.description: The Member's name.

role.description: The Member's role: `owner`, `employee`, or a role the Product adds.

suspended.description: Whether the Member is suspended: they keep their place but cannot enter the Company, because the Owner's Seats fall short.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

name: listSuspendedMembers
title: List a Company's Suspended Members
description: The Owner sees the Members of the Company who cannot enter it because the Owner's Seats fall short, the one suspended the longest first (the first to come back when a Seat is free): a page of `limit` (50 by default) and the `nextCursor` of the next page. Only the Owner may.

limit.description: How many items to answer, 1 to 100.

cursor.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page; without it, the first page.

name.description: The Member's name.

role.description: The Member's role: `owner`, `employee`, or a role the Product adds.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

name: removeMember
title: Remove a Member from a Company
description: The Owner removes another Member from the Company. From the next call on, the removed user gets 404 on every route of the Company, their agents included. The Owner cannot remove themselves (`OWNER_MUST_TRANSFER`).

annotations.title: Remove a Member from a Company

name: renameCompany
title: Rename a Company
description: Gives a Company a new name (the spaces around it are removed; names may repeat). Only its Owner may. The id, and so every link to the Company, stays the same. Answers the renamed Company.

name.description: The Company's name: 1 to 100 characters once the spaces around it are removed.

id.description: The Company's id: random, and it never changes.

name.description: The Company's name; several Companies may share it.

role.description: The signed-in user's role in the Company.

name: resendInvitation
title: Resend a pending Invitation
description: The Owner sends a pending Invitation again, with a new link (the previous one stops working) that lasts 7 more days. Works on an expired Invitation too.

role.description: The role the person will have: `employee` or a role the Product adds.

userId.description: The user id of whoever invited.

name.description: Their name.

invitedBy.description: Who invited; `null` once their account is deleted (the Invitation stays).

expiresAt.description: When the link stops working, 7 days after it was sent or last resent.

name: revokeConnection
title: Revoke one of the signed-in user's Connections
description: Deletes the Connection with this id and its tokens: the agent loses access at once and must be authorized again. Only the user's own Connections can be revoked.

annotations.title: Revoke one of the signed-in user's Connections

name: updateMe
title: Rename the signed-in user
description: Changes the name of the user the request acts for (the spaces around it are removed) and answers the user as getMe does.

name.description: The new name: 1 to 100 characters once the spaces around it are removed.
The user's name: the one they signed up with, or the last one they chose.

pendingEmail.description: The address the user asked to change their email to, until they open the link sent there; null when no change is pending.
